name: The Westin Anaheim Resort
positioning: A Westin across Katella Avenue from Disney California Adventure Park, within walking distance of the Disneyland Resort, with orchard-inspired biophilic design and park-view rooms
best_for: Families visiting the Disneyland Resort who want to walk to the parks
Guests who want a room with theme park and fireworks views

facts.text: The hotel is located across from the Disneyland Resort and next to the Anaheim Convention Center.
It sits directly across Katella Avenue from Disney California Adventure Park, within walking distance of the Disneyland Resort.
The hotel is a Disney Good Neighbor Hotel in the highest category, the Superior Hotel Category.
The hotel is arranged around a central courtyard, rises gradually up to eight stories, and uses biophilic design to connect guests to nature.
Live potted citrus trees line the entrance, the lobby and the rooftop.
A living green wall stands behind the check-in counters.
Most Theme Park View rooms offer the option of a balcony.
The 24-hour Westin WORKOUT Fitness Studio has floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the outdoor pool.
Family activities include Resort Art Quest, where kids search for clues to nature-inspired art pieces in the hotel, and Yoga Fun for Little Ones.
Concierge associates can help with Disney theme park ticket purchases and park reservations on-site, subject to availability.
RISE Rooftop Lounge is a tapas-style rooftop bar with live music and views of Disney California Adventure Park.

highlights.text: Theme Park View rooms, studios and suites look over Disney California Adventure Park and let guests watch the Disneyland Resort fireworks.
The private top-floor Westin Club Lounge has panoramic views of the Disneyland Resort through floor-to-ceiling windows.
The interior design is inspired by the modern orchard garden, a nod to Anaheim's agricultural origins.
A ground-level heated outdoor pool and whirlpool come with luxury cabanas.

considerations.text: The parks are a walk away rather than on site: the walk to the Disneyland Resort takes about 15 to 20 minutes for most visitors.
WhataHotel notes a high-traffic tourist area with frequent crowds.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing due to the Disney proximity.
